Jane can walk any distance in half the time it takes Hector to walk the same distance. They set off in opposite directions around the outside of the \(18\)-block area as shown. When they meet for the first time, they will be closest to

[Figure 1](attached-image-1)

In the figure, \(\angle A,\) \(\angle B\) and \(\angle C\) are right angles. If \(\angle AEB = 40^\circ\) and \(\angle BED = \angle BDE,\) then \(\angle CDE =\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-2)

The area of each of the four congruent L-shaped regions of this \(100\)-inch by \(100\)-inch square is \(\dfrac{3}{16}\) of the total area. How many inches long is the side of the center square?

[Figure 1](attached-image-3)

The graph shows the distribution of the number of children in the families of the students in Ms. Jordan’s English class. The median number of children in the family for this distribution is

[Figure 1](attached-image-4)

In parallelogram \(ABCD,\) \(\overline{DE}\) is the altitude to the base \(\overline{AB}\) and \(\overline{DF}\) is the altitude to the base \(\overline{BC}.\) (Both pictures represent the same parallelogram.) If \(DC = 12,\) \(EB = 4,\) and \(DE = 6,\) then \(DF =\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-5)

Two opposite sides of a rectangle are each divided into \(n\) congruent segments, and the endpoints of one segment are joined to the center to form triangle \(A.\) The other sides are each divided into \(m\) congruent segments, and the endpoints of one of these segments are joined to the center to form triangle \(B.\) [See figure for \(n=5,\) \(m=7.\)] What is the ratio of the area of triangle \(A\) to the area of triangle \(B?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-6)

In rectangle \(ABCD,\) angle \(C\) is trisected by \(\overline{CF}\) and \(\overline{CE},\) where \(E\) is on \(\overline{AB},\) \(F\) is on \(\overline{AD},\) \(BE=6,\) and \(AF=2.\) Which of the following is closest to the area of the rectangle \(ABCD?\)

[Figure 1](attached-image-7)

The midpoints of the sides of a regular hexagon \(ABCDEF\) are joined to form a smaller hexagon. What fraction of the area of \(ABCDEF\) is enclosed by the smaller hexagon?

[Figure 1](attached-image-8)
